## About
EDA Motors is a full-service auto repair shop in the Tysons and McLean area, on Spring Hill Road. We're independently owned, and we're an independent BMW specialist. We also service and repair all European, Domestic, and Asian vehicles.
Max, the owner, runs the shop with Houman. One reviewer wrote that Max took the time to patiently explain what needed to be done and kept her informed while the work was underway. Another said he still test drives cars himself before handing the keys back.
We're rated 4.8 from 34 Google reviews. If you have a question about service or getting around while your car is here, just give us a call.

## Services
- Engine Diagnostics: Finding out what's really going on before any work starts.
- Complete Brake Service: Brake inspection and repair for all makes.
- Factory Required Maintenance: The maintenance your manufacturer calls for, done on schedule.
- Transmission Repair: Transmission work for European, Domestic, and Asian vehicles.
- Computerized Alignment: Getting your wheels pointed straight.
- Air Conditioning: A/C service and repair.
- VA State & Emissions (with service): Virginia state and emissions inspections, done along with your service.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on BMWs?
A: No. We're a BMW specialist, but we also service and repair all European, Domestic, and Asian vehicles.

Q: Can I get my Virginia inspection done with you?
A: Yes, we do Virginia state and emissions inspections along with service.

Q: What can I do while my car is in the shop?
A: You can relax in our waiting room with TV and wireless Internet, or ask about a ride or a rental car.

Q: Who works on my car?
A: We employ ASE Certified technicians, and Max, the owner, is hands-on with the work.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: You can call us or request an appointment online.
